snippet.title: RollerGirl - Official Gameplay Trailer | Black Voices in Gaming
snippet.description: It's summer in the mid-2000s, and your car needs fixing. Strap on your rollerblades instead and set out on a wholesome journey of raising car funds. Ask your neighbors about odd jobs, blade introspectively through the rain, and rock to the soundtrack of your mp3 player.
